_comment: Runpod pod serving the model (Runpod v2 REST create-pod body; the Runpod MCP create-pod tool takes it as `body`). Replace VLLM_API_KEY with the VM's ~/.config/jev-bench/vllm_key (the proxy URL https://<POD_ID>-8000.proxy.runpod.net is public). Then write the pod id to ~/.config/jev-bench/pod_id on the VM. RTX PRO 6000 96GB: FP8 weights 29 GiB + FP8 KV 55.7 GiB (~1.2M tokens) = 20 agents at 128K with ~90% prefix-cache hits. The host needs CUDA >= 12.9 for this image. If no Workstation Edition is free, 'NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition' is the same chip. Drop the _comment key before sending.
name: jev-bench-vllm-128k

gpu.id: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
